raw_segments.text: It was easy for me to find out, and I did soon find out that Drummel had begun to follow
her closely, and that she allowed him to do it.
A little while, and he was always in pursuit of her, and he and I crossed one another every
He held on in a dull, persistent way, and Estella held him on, now with encouragement,
now with discouragement, now almost flattering him, now openly despising him, now knowing
him very well, now scarcely remembering who he was.
